name: Break the strongest
description: Concentrate on the largest remaining stack.

name: Focus Counters
description: Prefer the enemy your unit counters; fall back if it has none.

name: Target domain
description: Choose a domain to prioritize among reachable enemies.

name: Target tag
description: Choose a tag to prioritize within the selected domain.

name: Protect allies
description: Screen any ally from attacks; normal screens protect an extra 25%, but attacks deal 25% less damage.
